title: 运营订单列表
summary: 适合高频查询、批量处理和异常追踪的后台列表。
summaryEn: A back-office list for high-frequency lookup, bulk processing, and exception tracking.
visualTraits: 表头和行状态对齐
颜色只表达语义状态
次要字段降低对比度

promptHints.summary: 构建一个面向运营人员的高密度订单列表。
do: 固定关键列并让表头保持可见
筛选条件可回显和清空
批量操作只在选中记录后出现
avoid: 把每一行做成独立卡片
只用颜色区分订单状态
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a dense order list for operations teams.
doEn: Keep key columns and the header visible
Echo and clear filter values
Reveal bulk actions only after selection
avoidEn: Turn every row into a separate card
Use color as the only order status cue

title: 经营指标看板
summary: 用于快速判断趋势、异常和指标关系的数据总览。
summaryEn: A data overview for reading trends, anomalies, and metric relationships at a glance.
visualTraits: 数字与单位分层
图表颜色保持克制
异常项优先于装饰信息
visualTraitsEn: Numbers and units have clear hierarchy

promptHints.summary: 构建一个经营指标看板，先展示结论，再提供下钻依据。
do: 标明时间范围和数据口径
为趋势变化提供同比或环比
加载失败时保留其他可用模块
avoid: 堆叠无解释的大数字卡片
每张图使用不同配色
promptHints.summaryEn: Build an executive metrics dashboard that leads with conclusions and supports drill-down.
doEn: State the time range and metric definitions
Give trend changes a comparison baseline
Keep other modules usable when a chart fails
avoidEn: Stack unexplained big-number cards
Give every chart a different palette

title: AI 研究工作台
summary: 把资料、对话和生成结果放在同一任务上下文中的三栏工作台。
summaryEn: A three-pane workspace that keeps sources, conversation, and generated results in one task context.
visualTraits: 三栏宽度由任务优先级决定
生成状态与内容区紧密相连
引用可回到原文
visualTraitsEn: Generation state stays close to content

promptHints.summary: 构建一个资料、AI 对话和可编辑结果并行的研究工作台。
do: 明确区分用户输入、模型输出和引用
生成中允许取消
保留失败输入用于重试
avoid: 让聊天气泡占据全部页面
用无限动画代替具体处理状态
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a research workspace with sources, AI conversation, and an editable result side by side.
doEn: Separate user input, model output, and citations
Allow generation to be cancelled
Keep failed input available for retry
avoidEn: Let chat bubbles take over the page
Replace a concrete processing state with endless animation

title: 课程学习目录
summary: 兼顾课程发现、学习进度和继续学习入口的教育产品首页。
summaryEn: An education home page balancing course discovery, learning progress, and a clear continue-learning entry point.
visualTraits: 课程封面服务于识别而非装饰
进度信息靠近继续按钮
筛选条件保持简短

promptHints.summary: 构建一个以继续学习和课程发现为核心的课程目录。
do: 优先展示上次学习位置
区分未开始、学习中和已完成
空结果给出清除筛选入口
avoid: 每张课程卡展示过多营销文案
把学习进度藏进详情页
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a course catalog centered on continuing learning and discovering the next course.
doEn: Prioritize the last learning position
Distinguish not started, in progress, and complete
Offer a clear path out of empty results
avoidEn: Pack cards with marketing copy
Hide progress inside the detail page

title: 移动任务收件箱
summary: 面向单手操作的任务收集、分组和快速完成页面。
summaryEn: A one-hand mobile task inbox for capture, grouping, and fast completion.
structure: 按时间分组的任务列表
visualTraits: 触控目标不小于 44px
完成状态不能只靠删除线表达
主要操作位于拇指可达区
visualTraitsEn: Completion is not shown by strike-through alone

promptHints.summary: 构建一个适合单手操作的移动任务收件箱。
do: 快速新增后保持输入上下文
完成动作提供可撤销反馈
离线时保留本地编辑
avoid: 在小屏上堆叠多层筛选
依赖悬停显示关键操作
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a one-hand mobile task inbox for capture, grouping, and fast completion.
doEn: Keep input context after quick add
Offer undo after completion
Preserve local edits offline
avoidEn: Stack layers of filters on a small screen
Hide key actions behind hover

title: 产品发布落地页
summary: 用清晰价值、真实产品画面和单一行动路径完成产品介绍。
summaryEn: A product launch page built around clear value, real product evidence, and one action path.
structure: 首屏价值与真实产品视觉
visualTraits: 首屏只承担一个主要信息
产品本体在首屏可见
不同区段使用不同信息构图
visualTraitsEn: The first screen carries one main message

promptHints.summary: 构建一个直接展示产品价值和真实界面的发布落地页。
do: 首屏保留下一段内容提示
只设置一个主要 CTA 意图
表单错误就地说明
avoid: 用抽象渐变代替产品画面
重复排列相同三列卡片
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a launch page around clear value, real product evidence, and one action path.
doEn: Hint at the next section from the first screen
Give the page one primary CTA intent
Explain form errors in place
avoidEn: Replace product evidence with abstract gradients
Repeat the same three-card row

title: 客户账户详情
summary: 汇总客户身份、健康状态、关键关系和最近活动的详情页。
summaryEn: A customer detail page that brings identity, health, key relationships, and recent activity together.
visualTraits: 状态与更新时间同时展示
详情字段按任务分组
危险操作与常规操作分开
visualTraitsEn: Status and updated time appear together
Destructive and routine actions are separated

promptHints.summary: 构建一个便于客户成功人员扫描和跟进的账户详情页。
do: 在页头给出账户健康状态
记录关键字段的更新时间
活动时间轴支持按类型筛选
avoid: 把所有字段放进同一张大卡片
让危险操作与编辑按钮并列
promptHints.summaryEn: Build an account detail page for scanning and follow-up by customer-success teams.
doEn: Lead with account health
Show when key fields were updated
Let activity be filtered by type
avoidEn: Put every field in one giant card
Place destructive and edit actions side by side

title: 工作区权限配置
summary: 用于配置角色、成员范围和敏感权限的后台表单。
summaryEn: An admin form for configuring roles, member scope, and sensitive permissions.
visualTraits: 标签位于控件上方
继承权限有明确来源
高风险选项附带影响说明
visualTraitsEn: Inherited permissions have a clear source

promptHints.summary: 构建一个能解释权限影响并防止误操作的角色配置页。
do: 显示未保存变更
高风险权限二次确认
错误信息紧邻对应字段
avoid: 用 placeholder 代替字段标签
保存失败后清空用户输入
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a role settings page that explains permission impact and prevents mistakes.
doEn: Show unsaved changes
Confirm high-risk permissions twice
Keep errors beside the affected field
avoidEn: Use a placeholder instead of a field label
Clear user input after a failed save

title: 数据导入向导
summary: 把上传、字段映射、校验和提交拆成可恢复的连续流程。
summaryEn: A recoverable flow that separates upload, field mapping, validation, and submission.
visualTraits: 步骤名称直接描述任务
错误按行和字段定位
提交前显示影响范围
visualTraitsEn: Errors point to row and field

promptHints.summary: 构建一个可恢复的数据导入向导。
do: 返回上一步时保留输入
校验错误提供定位和下载
导入中显示处理数量
avoid: 只用 Step 1 这类无意义标签
失败后要求重新上传文件
doEn: Preserve input when going back
Locate and download validation errors
Show processed counts while importing
avoidEn: Use meaningless labels such as Step 1
Require a new upload after failure

title: 审批活动时间轴
summary: 按时间展示审批节点、处理人、意见和当前等待对象。
summaryEn: A timeline showing approval steps, owners, comments, and the person currently blocking progress.
visualTraits: 当前节点最突出
历史节点可快速扫描
意见与系统事件视觉区分
visualTraitsEn: Comments and system events look different

promptHints.summary: 构建一个能快速回答当前卡在哪里的审批时间轴。
do: 显示当前等待对象和已等待时长
系统事件与人工意见分开
处理失败保留填写内容
avoid: 所有节点使用相同强调级别
只显示状态不显示处理人
promptHints.summaryEn: Build an approval timeline that answers where the request is blocked.
doEn: Show the current owner and wait time
Separate system events from human comments
Preserve form input after a failed action
avoidEn: Give every node the same emphasis
Show status without the responsible person

title: 问题分诊看板
summary: 按处理阶段组织问题，并保留优先级、负责人和阻塞信息。
summaryEn: A triage board organized by stage with priority, owner, and blocker context intact.
visualTraits: 列宽稳定避免拖动抖动
卡片只保留分诊所需字段
阻塞原因直接可见
visualTraitsEn: Stable column widths prevent drag jitter

promptHints.summary: 构建一个用于快速分诊问题的横向看板。
do: 拖动后立即确认目标状态
保留键盘操作路径
空列提示可接受的下一步
avoid: 把完整问题描述塞进卡片
仅靠卡片颜色表示优先级
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a horizontal issue-triage board for fast sorting.
doEn: Confirm the destination after dragging
Keep a keyboard path
Give empty columns a useful next step
avoidEn: Put the full issue description in each card
Use card color as the only priority cue

title: 批量操作结果
summary: 同时说明成功、失败和可继续处理项的结果反馈页。
summaryEn: A result page that separates successes, failures, and items that can be processed again.
visualTraits: 结论文字优先于图标
成功和失败数量可核对
主要操作根据结果变化

promptHints.summary: 构建一个能处理部分成功场景的批量操作结果页。
do: 明确总数、成功数和失败数
允许只重试失败项
保留可下载的错误明细
avoid: 部分成功时只显示绿色成功页
用短暂 toast 承载全部结果
promptHints.summaryEn: Build a bulk-operation result page that handles partial success.
doEn: State total, success, and failure counts
Retry only failed items
Keep downloadable error details
avoidEn: Show only a green success page for partial success
Put the entire result in a short-lived toast
